verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD . . .
verses.literalPt: A PALAVRA que do SENHOR veio a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּתָב־ לְךָ֗ אֵ֧ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי אֵלֶ֖יךָ אֶל־ סֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr kə·ṯāḇ- lə·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tî ’ê·le·ḵā ’el- sê·p̄er
verses.literal: This is what the LORD the God of Israel . . . says Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Escreve num livro todas as palavras que te tenho falado.

verses.original: כִּ֠י הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְ֠שַׁבְתִּי אֶת־ שְׁב֨וּת עַמִּ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִֽיהוּדָ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֗ים אֶל־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לַאֲבוֹתָ֖ם וִֽירֵשֽׁוּהָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- šə·ḇūṯ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh ’ā·mar Yah·weh wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯîm ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wî·rê·šū·hā
verses.literal: For behold the days are coming declares the LORD when I will restore from captivity My people Israel and Judah declares the LORD I will restore them to the land that I gave to their fathers and they will possess it
verses.literalPt: Porque eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que farei voltar do cativeiro o meu povo Israel, e de Judá, diz o SENHOR; e tornarei a trazê-los à terra que dei a seus pais, e a possuirão.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְאֶל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’el- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: These are the words that the LORD spoke concerning Israel . . . and Judah
verses.literalPt: E estas são as palavras que disse o SENHOR, acerca de Israel e de Judá.

verses.original: כִּי־ כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חֲרָדָ֖ה שָׁמָ֑עְנוּ פַּ֖חַד וְאֵ֥ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh qō·wl ḥă·rā·ḏāh šā·mā·‘ə·nū pa·ḥaḏ wə·’ên šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Yes this is what the LORD says A cry of panic is heard a cry of terror not of peace
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: Ouvimos uma voz de tremor, de temor mas não de paz.

verses.original: שַׁאֲלוּ־ נָ֣א וּרְא֔וּ אִם־ יֹלֵ֖ד זָכָ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ רָאִ֨יתִי כָל־ גֶּ֜בֶר יָדָ֤יו עַל־ חֲלָצָיו֙ כַּיּ֣וֹלֵדָ֔ה וְנֶהֶפְכ֥וּ כָל־ פָּנִ֖ים לְיֵרָקֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ša·’ă·lū- nā ū·rə·’ū ’im- yō·lêḏ zā·ḵār mad·dū·a‘ rā·’î·ṯî ḵāl ge·ḇer yā·ḏāw ‘al- ḥă·lā·ṣāw kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh wə·ne·hep̄·ḵū ḵāl pā·nîm lə·yê·rā·qō·wn
verses.literal: Ask now and see Can a male give birth Why then do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor and every face turned pale
verses.literalPt: Perguntai, pois, e vede, se um homem pode dar à luz. Por que, pois, vejo a cada homem com as mãos sobre os lombos como a que está dando à luz? e por que se tornaram pálidos todos os rostos?

verses.original: ה֗וֹי כִּ֥י גָד֛וֹל הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא מֵאַ֣יִן כָּמֹ֑הוּ וְעֵֽת־ צָרָ֥ה הִיא֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּמִמֶּ֖נָּה יִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w kî ḡā·ḏō·wl hay·yō·wm ha·hū mê·’a·yin kā·mō·hū wə·‘êṯ- ṣā·rāh hî lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·mim·men·nāh yiw·wā·šê·a‘
verses.literal: How . . . awful that day will be None will be like it It is the time of Jacob’s distress but he will be saved out of it
verses.literalPt: Ah! porque aquele dia é tão grande, que não houve outro semelhante; e é tempo de angústia para Jacó; ele, porém, será salvo dela.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם׀ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אֶשְׁבֹּ֤ר עֻלּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֔ךָ וּמוֹסְרוֹתֶ֖יךָ אֲנַתֵּ֑ק וְלֹא־ יַעַבְדוּ־ ב֥וֹ ע֖וֹד זָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm ha·hū nə·’um Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’eš·bōr ‘ul·lōw mê·‘al ṣaw·wā·re·ḵā ū·mō·ws·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā ’ă·nat·têq wə·lō- ya·‘aḇ·ḏū- ḇōw ‘ō·wḏ zā·rîm
verses.literal: On that day declares the LORD of Hosts I will break the yoke off their necks and tear off their bonds and no longer will strangers enslave them
verses.literalPt: Porque será naquele dia, diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos, que eu quebrarei o seu jugo de sobre o teu pescoço, e quebrarei os teus grilhões; e nunca mais se servirão dele os estrangeiros.

verses.original: וְעָ֣בְד֔וּ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וְאֵת֙ דָּוִ֣ד מַלְכָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָקִ֖ים לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏū ’êṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·’êṯ dā·wiḏ mal·kām ’ă·šer ’ā·qîm lā·hem
verses.literal: Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and David their king whom I will raise up for them
verses.literalPt: Mas servirão ao SENHOR, seu Deus, como também a Davi, seu rei, que lhes levantarei.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה אַל־ תִּירָא֩ עַבְדִּ֨י יַעֲקֹ֤ב נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָה֙ וְאַל־ תֵּחַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֤י מוֹשִֽׁיעֲךָ֙ מֵֽרָח֔וֹק וְאֶֽת־ זַרְעֲךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁבְיָ֑ם וְשָׁ֧ב יַעֲקֹ֛ב וְשָׁקַ֥ט וְשַׁאֲנַ֖ן וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’al- tî·rā ‘aḇ·dî ya·‘ă·qōḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·’al- tê·ḥaṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî hin·nî mō·wō·šî·‘ă·ḵā mê·rā·ḥō·wq wə·’eṯ- zar·‘ă·ḵā mê·’e·reṣ šiḇ·yām wə·šāḇ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·šā·qaṭ wə·ša·’ă·nan wə·’ên ma·ḥă·rîḏ
verses.literal: As for you O Jacob My servant do not be afraid declares the LORD and do not be dismayed O Israel For I will surely save you out of a distant place your descendants from the land of their captivity Jacob will return to quiet and ease with no one to make him afraid
verses.literalPt: Não temas, pois, tu, ó meu servo Jacó, diz o SENHOR, nem te espantes, ó Israel; porque eis que te livrarei de terras de longe, e à tua descendência da terra do seu cativeiro; e Jacó voltará, e descansará, e ficará em sossego, e não haverá quem o atemorize.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אִתְּךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה לְהֽוֹשִׁיעֶ֑ךָ כִּי֩ אֶעֱשֶׂ֨ה כָלָ֜ה בְּכָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם׀ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֲפִצוֹתִ֣יךָ שָּׁ֗ם אַ֤ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֙ לֹֽא־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה כָלָ֔ה וְיִסַּרְתִּ֙יךָ֙ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֥א אֲנַקֶּֽךָּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî- ’it·tə·ḵā ’ă·nî nə·’um- Yah·weh lə·hō·wō·šî·‘e·ḵā kî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḵā·lāh bə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer hă·p̄i·ṣō·w·ṯî·ḵā šām ’aḵ ’ō·ṯə·ḵā lō- ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ḵā·lāh wə·yis·sar·tî·ḵā lam·miš·pāṭ wə·naq·qêh lō ’ă·naq·qe·kā
verses.literal: For I am with you to save you declares the LORD Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have scattered you . . . - I will not completely destroy you . . . Yet I will discipline you justly and will by no means leave you unpunished . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sou contigo, diz o SENHOR, para te salvar; porquanto darei fim a todas as nações entre as quais te espalhei; a ti, porém, não darei fim, mas castigar-te-ei com medida, e de todo não te terei por inocente.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אָנ֣וּשׁ לְשִׁבְרֵ֑ךְ נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ā·nūš lə·šiḇ·rêḵ naḥ·lāh mak·kā·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says Your injury is incurable your wound is grievous
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o SENHOR: A tua ferida é incurável; a tua chaga é dolorosa.

verses.original: אֵֽין־ דָּ֥ן דִּינֵ֖ךְ לְמָז֑וֹר רְפֻא֥וֹת תְּעָלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- dān dî·nêḵ lə·mā·zō·wr rə·p̄u·’ō·wṯ tə·‘ā·lāh ’ên lāḵ
verses.literal: There is no one to plead your cause no remedy for your sores no recovery for you
verses.literalPt: Não há quem defenda a tua causa para te aplicar curativo; não tens remédios que possam curar.

verses.original: כָּל־ מְאַהֲבַ֣יִךְ שְׁכֵח֔וּךְ אוֹתָ֖ךְ לֹ֣א יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ כִּי֩ מַכַּ֨ת אוֹיֵ֤ב הִכִּיתִיךְ֙ מוּסַ֣ר אַכְזָרִ֔י עַ֚ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֵ֔ךְ עָצְמ֖וּ חַטֹּאתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mə·’a·hă·ḇa·yiḵ šə·ḵê·ḥūḵ ’ō·w·ṯāḵ lō yiḏ·rō·šū kî mak·kaṯ ’ō·w·yêḇ hik·kî·ṯîḵ mū·sar ’aḵ·zā·rî ‘al rōḇ ‘ă·wō·nêḵ ‘ā·ṣə·mū ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯā·yiḵ
verses.literal: All your lovers have forgotten you they no longer seek you for . . . I have struck you as an enemy would with the discipline of someone cruel because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins
verses.literalPt: Todos os teus amantes se esqueceram de ti, e não perguntam por ti; porque te feri com ferida de inimigo, e com castigo de quem é cruel, pela grandeza da tua maldade e multidão de teus pecados.

verses.original: מַה־ תִּזְעַק֙ עַל־ שִׁבְרֵ֔ךְ אָנ֖וּשׁ מַכְאֹבֵ֑ךְ עַ֣ל׀ רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנֵ֗ךְ עָֽצְמוּ֙ חַטֹּאתַ֔יִךְ עָשִׂ֥יתִי אֵ֖לֶּה לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: mah- tiz·‘aq ‘al- šiḇ·rêḵ ’ā·nūš maḵ·’ō·ḇêḵ ‘al rōḇ ‘ă·wō·nêḵ ‘ā·ṣə·mū ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯa·yiḵ ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’êl·leh lāḵ
verses.literal: Why do you cry out over your wound Your pain has no cure Because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins I have done these things to you
verses.literalPt: Por que gritas por causa da tua ferida? Tua dor é incurável. Pela grandeza de tua maldade, e multidão de teus pecados, eu fiz estas coisas.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כָּל־ אֹכְלַ֙יִךְ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔לוּ וְכָל־ צָרַ֥יִךְ כֻּלָּ֖ם בַּשְּׁבִ֣י יֵלֵ֑כוּ וְהָי֤וּ שֹׁאסַ֙יִךְ֙ לִמְשִׁסָּ֔ה וְכָל־ בֹּזְזַ֖יִךְ אֶתֵּ֥ן לָבַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kāl- ’ō·ḵə·la·yiḵ yê·’ā·ḵê·lū wə·ḵāl ṣā·ra·yiḵ kul·lām baš·šə·ḇî yê·lê·ḵū wə·hā·yū šō·sa·yiḵ lim·šis·sāh wə·ḵāl bō·zə·za·yiḵ ’et·tên lā·ḇaz
verses.literal: Nevertheless all who devour you will be devoured and all your adversaries every one of them will go off into exile Those who plundered you will be plundered . . . and all who raided you will be raided . . .
verses.literalPt: Por isso todos os que te devoram serão devorados; e todos os teus adversários irão, todos eles, para o cativeiro; e os que te roubam serão roubados, e a todos os que te despojam entregarei ao saque.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אַעֲלֶ֨ה אֲרֻכָ֥ה לָ֛ךְ וּמִמַּכּוֹתַ֥יִךְ אֶרְפָּאֵ֖ךְ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י נִדָּחָה֙ קָ֣רְאוּ לָ֔ךְ צִיּ֣וֹן הִ֔יא דֹּרֵ֖שׁ אֵ֥ין לָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’a·‘ă·leh ’ă·ru·ḵāh lāḵ ū·mim·mak·kō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ’er·pā·’êḵ nə·’um- Yah·weh kî nid·dā·ḥāh qā·rə·’ū lāḵ ṣî·yō·wn hî dō·rêš ’ên lāh
verses.literal: But I will restore your health and heal your wounds declares the LORD because they call you an outcast Zion for whom no one cares
verses.literalPt: Porque te restaurarei a saúde, e te curarei as tuas chagas, diz o SENHOR; porquanto te chamaram a repudiada, dizendo: É Sião, já ninguém pergunta por ela.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְנִי־ שָׁב֙ שְׁבוּת֙ אָהֳלֵ֣י יַֽעֲק֔וֹב וּמִשְׁכְּנֹתָ֖יו אֲרַחֵ֑ם וְנִבְנְתָ֥ה עִיר֙ עַל־ תִּלָּ֔הּ וְאַרְמ֖וֹן עַל־ מִשְׁפָּט֥וֹ יֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hin·nî- šāḇ šə·ḇūṯ ’ā·ho·lê ya·‘ă·qō·wḇ ū·miš·kə·nō·ṯāw ’ă·ra·ḥêm wə·niḇ·nə·ṯāh ‘îr ‘al- til·lāh wə·’ar·mō·wn ‘al- miš·pā·ṭōw yê·šêḇ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD . . . says I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings And the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins and the palace will stand in its rightful place
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR: Eis que farei voltar do cativeiro as tendas de Jacó, e apiedar-me-ei das suas moradas; e a cidade será reedificada sobre o seu montão, e o palácio permanecerá como habitualmente.

verses.original: וְיָצָ֥א מֵהֶ֛ם תּוֹדָ֖ה וְק֣וֹל מְשַׂחֲקִ֑ים וְהִרְבִּתִים֙ וְלֹ֣א יִמְעָ֔טוּ וְהִכְבַּדְתִּ֖ים וְלֹ֥א יִצְעָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā mê·hem tō·w·ḏāh wə·qō·wl mə·śa·ḥă·qîm wə·hir·bi·ṯîm wə·lō yim·‘ā·ṭū wə·hiḵ·baḏ·tîm wə·lō yiṣ·‘ā·rū
verses.literal: Thanksgiving will proceed from them a sound of celebration I will multiply them and they will not be decreased I will honor them and they will not be belittled
verses.literalPt: E sairá deles o louvor e a voz de júbilo; e multiplicá-los-ei, e não serão diminuídos, e glorificá-los-ei, e não serão apoucados.

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ בָנָיו֙ כְּקֶ֔דֶם וַעֲדָת֖וֹ לְפָנַ֣י תִּכּ֑וֹן וּפָ֣קַדְתִּ֔י עַ֖ל כָּל־ לֹחֲצָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ḇā·nāw kə·qe·ḏem wa·‘ă·ḏā·ṯōw lə·p̄ā·nay tik·kō·wn ū·p̄ā·qaḏ·tî ‘al kāl- lō·ḥă·ṣāw
verses.literal: Their children will be as in days of old and their congregation will be established before Me and I will punish . . . all their oppressors
verses.literalPt: E seus filhos serão como na antiguidade, e a sua congregação será confirmada diante de mim; e castigarei todos os seus opressores.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה אַדִּיר֜וֹ מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וּמֹֽשְׁלוֹ֙ מִקִּרְבּ֣וֹ יֵצֵ֔א וְהִקְרַבְתִּ֖יו וְנִגַּ֣שׁ אֵלָ֑י כִּי֩ מִ֨י הוּא־ זֶ֜ה עָרַ֧ב אֶת־ לִבּ֛וֹ לָגֶ֥שֶׁת אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ad·dî·rōw mim·men·nū ū·mō·šə·lōw miq·qir·bōw yê·ṣê wə·hiq·raḇ·tîw wə·nig·gaš ’ê·lāy kî mî hū- zeh ‘ā·raḇ ’eṯ- lib·bōw lā·ḡe·šeṯ ’ê·lay nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Their leader will be one of their own and their ruler will arise from their midst And I will bring him near and he will approach Me for who . . . . . . would dare on his own to approach Me declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: E os seus nobres serão deles; e o seu governador sairá do meio deles, e o farei aproximar, e ele se chegará a mim; pois, quem de si mesmo se empenharia para chegar-se a mim? diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וִהְיִ֥יתֶם לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wih·yî·ṯem lî lə·‘ām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’eh·yeh lā·ḵem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: And you will be My people and I will be your God
verses.literalPt: E ser-me-eis por povo, e eu vos serei por Deus.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ סַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה חֵמָה֙ יָֽצְאָ֔ה סַ֖עַר מִתְגּוֹרֵ֑ר עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ רְשָׁעִ֖ים יָחֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh sa·‘ă·raṯ Yah·weh ḥê·māh yā·ṣə·’āh sa·‘ar miṯ·gō·w·rêr ‘al rōš rə·šā·‘îm yā·ḥūl
verses.literal: Behold the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury a whirlwind . . . swirling down upon the heads of the wicked
verses.literalPt: Eis que a tempestade do SENHOR, a sua indignação, já saiu; uma tempestade varredora, cairá cruelmente sobre a cabeça dos ímpios.

verses.original: לֹ֣א יָשׁ֗וּב חֲרוֹן֙ אַף־ יְהוָ֔ה עַד־ עֲשֹׂת֥וֹ וְעַד־ הֲקִימ֖וֹ מְזִמּ֣וֹת לִבּ֑וֹ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִ֖ים תִּתְבּ֥וֹנְנוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō yā·šūḇ ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh ‘aḏ- ‘ă·śō·ṯōw wə·‘aḏ- hă·qî·mōw mə·zim·mō·wṯ lib·bōw bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm tiṯ·bō·wn·nū ḇāh
verses.literal: The fierce anger of the LORD . . . will not turn back until He has fully accomplished . . . . . . the purposes of His heart In the days to come you will understand this
verses.literalPt: Não voltará atrás o furor da ira do SENHOR, até que tenha executado e até que tenha cumprido os desígnios do seu coração; no fim dos dias entendereis isto.
